title: Message/queryChanges loads all messages into memory via list_by_chat(u32::MAX)
description: queryChanges calls list_by_chat(&chat_id, u32::MAX) to build a reference list for position() lookups. On a busy chat this loads every message row into memory on every queryChanges call. Position should be computed in SQL (e.g. ROW_NUMBER() or a subquery COUNT) rather than by deserializing all rows.
